subject: Re: Redwood inference — EoQ timing & priority check
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmecloud.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood inference — discovery recap + next steps

Jordan / Samantha — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call so we have the same next steps:

- Problem: AcmeCloud is seeing latency spikes on interactive search features and token costs have increased 2x this quarter.
- What we discussed: Redwood can reduce p50 latency by ~30–50ms and lower per-token unit cost via batching + KV prefix cache.
- Proposed pilot: 2-week PoC on a subset of production traffic (search endpoint), Redwood provides integration support + performance baseline.
- Success criteria: p50 latency <= target 120ms and token cost reduction >= 20% vs current baseline.
- Timeline you mentioned: internal budget/approval by end of June; pilot kickoff early July if approved.

Next steps from our side: I attached a short one-pager outlining the pilot scope and what the integration looks like (Redwood_Prod_OnePager.pdf). Can you confirm a few things so I can lock resources?

1) Is the end-of-June budget/approval timeline still the target?
2) Who is the approver we should loop into the mutual action plan?
3) Any technical guardrails we should be aware of (VPC, data residency, etc.)?

If it's easier, happy to jump on a 20-min call with the approver this week — Marissa (cc'd) will be our SE for the pilot.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

If the end-of-June approval is still expected, we can hold the pilot resources and prioritize onboarding so you can hit early-July kickoff. If timelines slipped, let me know what the new target is and we'll adapt.

- If priority shifted, reply with new target date and any blockers

Appreciate the update — we want to make sure we allocate the right SE time and GPU slots.

Happy EoQ — quick priority check.

We last spoke about a pilot to address your latency and cost goals; you mentioned internal approval was expected by the end of June. We're now at EoQ and I wanted to see if that timeline held or if priorities/budget shifted. A couple quick asks so we can plan: 

- Is budget/approval still on track for this quarter?
- If not, what quarter should we tentatively target instead (Q3 / Q4)?
- If you want, we can offer a 2-week accelerated onboarding and priority SE support for EoQ/early-Q3 customers — happy to discuss details.

If I don't hear back, I'll follow up once at the start of next month. If it'd help to get the approver on a short call today/this week, I'm available between 11–3 PT.

Thanks for the update — even a one-line note is helpful so we can align resources.
